The case went to a person, not to the team. The refund runbook says refund moves money, no fix may be made automatically, and every exception except two expected ones goes to payments. This is an unexpected `System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException` on order 1005, so it's theirs to check.

The error points to `OrderService.OrderApi.RefundOrder` in `src/OrderService/Api/Refund.cs` at line 12, where a `Substring` call received a negative start index (-4). Nothing in this error shows whether the customer was refunded, so payments needs to check that for order 1005 before anyone retries. The case is written up for them at `demos/louis-agent/data/triage/people/eval-refund-1005.md`.
